gc_pause_max.note: The worst single collector step, not a rate. design.md 5.2 calls the maximum GC pause the project's recurring problem and testing.md 18.5 is explicit that the maximum is what matters, never the average.
gc_pause_max.unit: counter ticks per operation, QEMU -icount shift=0

ipc_roundtrip.note: A minimal message: the floor of the IPC path. Compare with `serialize`, which is what a message carrying a real Lua table costs on top.
ipc_roundtrip.unit: counter ticks per operation, QEMU -icount shift=0

serialize.note: 5% rather than 2%: kosmos_lua_seed randomises string hashing per boot, so table iteration order and therefore the pack order differ run to run. Observed spread is about 0.6%. The randomisation is deliberate and worth more than a tighter bound on this one number.
serialize.unit: counter ticks per operation, QEMU -icount shift=0
